name: Language
note: The language a member is written to in. It is not the set of locales the frontend has catalogs for — that set is smaller and is a frontend concern, so it does not belong here (contracts/AGENTS.md, working rule 3). The policy is 'ignore_and_warn' because that is what legacy does: an unknown or absent language falls back to the default instead of refusing the request, and a registration must not fail over the browser's locale.
